narrative:
January–September campaigns returned only NOK 3.3M of incremental gross margin, because two campaigns destroyed margin. The Anton Sport summer sale lifted units 14% but returned −NOK 4.1M (40% depth, NOK 2.3M of media, 61% pull-forward). The Intersport & Sport 1 summer sale returned −NOK 0.9M.

Black Friday is planned at the same 40% depth for Anton Sport.

signals.title: Anton Sport summer sale returned −NOK 4.1M margin ROI
signals.source: SDP Promotion ROI — campaign uplift vs markdown & media cost
signals.excerpt: Units rose 14%, but markdown depth of 40% on lifestyle footwear and NOK 2.3M of media turned the campaign margin-negative. Black Friday 2026 should cap depth at 30% on full-price lines.
